title: Binary Vector Conversion
text: Convert scalar integer to binary logic vector and vice versa, 1 input, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Datatype of output scalar; {Convert} sets the type of conversion operation Scalar to binary-coded, {Logical vector encoding} sets the method of encoding logical vector Unipolar, {Input vector length} sets the number of vector elements in input vector and {Output vector length} sets the number of vector elements in output vector. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Convert
params.values: Type of conversion operation Scalar to binary-coded vector (default) | Binary-coded vector to scalar | Resize binary-coded vector | Reverse binary-coded vector

params.name: Logical vector encoding
params.values: Method of encoding logical vector Unipolar (magnitude) (default) | Bipolar (2’s complement)

params.name: Input vector length
params.values: Number of vector elements in input vector 8 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Output vector length
params.values: Number of vector elements in output vector 8 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Datatype of output scalar double (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | single | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | fixdt(0,16)
